relationships.subject: nocebo hyperalgesia
relationships.evidence_quote: there were significantly increased activations bilaterally in the amygdala, ACC, and insula, during nocebo compared to control trials

relationships.subject: D-cycloserine
relationships.evidence_quote: Nocebo magnitudes and brain activations did not show significant differences between D-cycloserine and placebo

key_findings: Nocebo hyperalgesia increased ACC, amygdala, insula and vlPFC activation.
Partial NMDA agonist D-cycloserine did not alter nocebo magnitude or brain activation.
